name: Dark Ceremony
summary: At Camp Mojache, Rok Orhan studies the Gordunni Scroll and seeks an orb from a Gordunni mage-lord. He hopes it will reveal more about the ceremony and the Gordunni's magic.

sections.title: Plans for a Dark Ceremony
sections.body: Rok Orhan reads the Gordunni Scroll as plans for a dark ceremony. He believes the Gordunni mage-lords conduct it. Find one of them and take his orb. A mage's orb holds great power, and Rok hopes it will teach him more about the ceremony and the magic the Gordunni wield.

sections.title: When the Orb Is Delivered
sections.body: Rok Orhan expects the orb to teach him more about the Gordunni. He will use what he learns to plan their downfall.

faq.answer: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache gives it after reading the Gordunni Scroll you brought.

faq.q: Who carries out the dark ceremony?
aliases: who is performing the dark ceremony
faq.answer: Rok Orhan reads the plans as showing that the Gordunni mage-lords conduct the ceremony.

faq.q: What orb is Rok Orhan after?
faq.answer: Rok Orhan wants an orb taken from one of the Gordunni mage-lords. A mage's orb holds great power, and he expects it to teach him more about the ceremony and the Gordunni's magic.
The chain continues with The Gordunni Orb.
